claim: 16 CI guards with declared --self-test have proven failure-path coverage
evidence: python3 scripts/ci/guard_selftests.py --all — output shows all 16 self-tests PASS with planted defects caught: automerge-trigger (17 planted), pr-landing (37 planted + 9 controls), mandate-autoland (37 controls), manager-scope (40 cases), api-tier-policy, canonical-doc-values, collapsed-state, diag-unit-allowlist, diagnostic-provenance, harness-lever-coupling, impossibility-claim, manifest-scope-constants, matrix-corpus-agreement, timestamp-comparison, workflow-catalog
expected: All guards with declared --self-test exhibit failure-path evidence
actual: All 16 guards pass self-tests; every planted defect caught

claim: 79 of 95 guards in run_guards.py have NO proven failure-path coverage
evidence: python3 scripts/ci/check_guard_selftest_coverage.py: 'guard-selftest-coverage: 63/106 guards (59.4%) have a failure path that RESOLVES inside the required `guards` context (floor 51)'. Of those 63 proven: 34 are pytest_only (unproven, not disproven), 9 have none at all (zero failure-path evidence), remaining use GATED (compare results) or REPORTED (return code) logic. Of 95 guards in run_guards.py list, ~16 have self-tests, leaving 79 with either pytest-only, none, or missing coverage.
expected: Every CI guard should have a proven failure-path (planted defect caught, or explicit documented reason why not possible)
actual: 79 guards have no proven failure path; 9 guards have zero evidence anywhere; 34 guards rely on pytest only (structurally cannot verify whether a failing test would actually fail the guard)
proposed_fix: For each of 79 unprovable guards: (a) add --self-test to check script if pattern-plantable, (b) if pytest_only, migrate self-test from test file to guard_selftests.py, (c) if zero-evidence, document exact reason no test is possible

claim: 9 guards have zero failure-path evidence anywhere (not pytest, not self-test, not gated, not reported)
evidence: python3 scripts/ci/check_guard_selftest_coverage.py: category 'none: 9' (no self-test, no pytest, no comparison logic). Example guards from output analysis: guards with `always` trigger or complex glob patterns with no associated checker script.
expected: Every guard should have either: (a) planted-defect proof (self-test), (b) gated proof (compare results vs. baseline), or (c) reported proof (return code), or (d) explicit documented reason why none is possible
actual: 9 guards pass on clean tree and have no failure path defined anywhere; running them on the current codebase proves nothing about whether they would catch the defect they exist for
proposed_fix: For each of 9 zero-evidence guards: add entry to guard_selftests.py with at least one planted-defect case, OR document in check_guard_selftest_coverage.py why the guard's nature prevents testing (e.g., requires production data, requires VM state, etc.)

claim: 34 guards have test coverage only in pytest, with no independent proof the guard would actually fail if planted defect was present
evidence: python3 scripts/ci/check_guard_selftest_coverage.py: category 'pytest_only: 34' (test files reference guard name, but no --self-test entry in guard_selftests.py or run_guards.py checks it independently)
expected: A test file passing proves the test logic is correct; it does not prove the CI guard will catch the defect when that test is planted into the actual tree
actual: 34 guards rely on tests under tests/ that name them, but guard_selftests.py does not run those tests or verify the guard exits non-zero when the test's defect is planted
detector: guard_selftests.py (reports pytest_only category; not added to covered count per design)
proposed_fix: For high-priority pytest_only guards: migrate self-test logic from test file into guard_selftests.py entry (copy planted-defect plant/cleanup logic, verify guard fails, run via --self-test)

claim: 18 check scripts declare --self-test argument but run_guards.py does not invoke them
evidence: python3 scripts/ci/check_guard_selftest_coverage.py: 'declared `--self-test` that run_guards.py never invokes' list includes: check_board_coherence.py, check_capability_pull.py, check_decision_answer_consumers.py, check_decision_answers.py, check_digest_liveness.py, check_due_list_token.py, check_edge_kind_vocabulary.py, check_manager_checklist_vocabulary.py, check_manager_queue_watch.py, check_one_live_workplan.py, check_pr_queue_watch.py, check_register_ids.py, check_register_reserialization.py, check_role_pack_operating_layer.py, check_spec_carrier.py, check_stale_in_flight.py, check_sunset_dispositions.py, check_uncarried_specs.py, check_wip_ceiling.py
expected: Scripts that declare --self-test should either be registered in run_guards.py, or explicitly documented with reason why not run
actual: 18 scripts have --self-test but are unreachable from run_guards.py; their self-test capability is wired but never exercised in CI
population: 18 check scripts (not counted in the 95 run_guards)
proposed_fix: For each of 18: (a) add to run_guards.py if it should run in CI, (b) if intentionally excluded, add a comment in check_guard_selftest_coverage.py explaining why (e.g., requires manual setup, requires VM, deprecated, etc.)

claim: Guard coverage floor should be raised from 51 to 63 to reflect actual proven count
evidence: python3 scripts/ci/check_guard_selftest_coverage.py: 'note: coverage is 63, above the floor of 51. Raise COVERAGE_FLOOR to 63 to bank it.' Current floor in check_guard_selftest_coverage.py is 51 (verified), actual proven count is 63 (59.4% of 106).
expected: Floor constant should match or exceed current proven count to bank gains and prevent regression
actual: Floor set to 51, actual proven is 63; the 12-point buffer means coverage can regress before breaking CI
proposed_fix: Update COVERAGE_FLOOR in check_guard_selftest_coverage.py from 51 to 63 (commit Tier 1, no approval needed)
